hec.script

Class ClientAppWrapper

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.script.ClientAppWrapper
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    ResSim

    public class ClientAppWrapper
extends java.lang.Object
    ClientApp is a wrapper class for scripting that contains only static methods that make performing certain tasks in the application easier for the script writer.
    Author:
    Mark Ackerman, RMA
